parents.instruction: Rate 0–10 how much the abstract clusters currently fashionable technical terms or named paradigms such as LLM, diffusion, NeRF, Transformer, or foundation-model language; judge only terminology frequency, not whether the research is good.

parents.criterion: Concrete, vivid endpoint achievement stated in plain language
parents.instruction: Score whether the abstract includes at least one concrete, vivid, easily-visualized achievement stated in plain language, as opposed to only abstract percentage deltas. 10 = the abstract names a specific, memorable, real-world-legible milestone (e.g., 'first to reach X', a named game/benchmark landmark). 0 = all claimed achievements are stated only as abstract numeric deltas with no plain-language milestone.

On a scale of 0 (extremely terse, roughly 1-3 sentences total) to 10 (extremely long and exhaustive, 250+ words across multiple sentences/paragraphs), rate how much raw length/verbosity this abstract exhibits by counting approximate sentence and word volume. Do NOT judge whether the length is appropriate or whether the underlying paper is good; score only the extent of textual volume present.
